item.title: Biden-era illegal immigrant convicted of groping teen girls as critics blast Soros-backed prosecutor
item.summary: Israel Flores Ortiz, an illegal alien who allegedly groped more than a dozen high school girls in Fairfax County, Virginia, was found guilty on nine counts of assault and battery.

item.title: AMB GORDON SONDLAND: NATO blinked on Iran, and Trump has every right to be furious
item.summary: A former U.S. ambassador to the EU argues NATO's hesitation after strikes on Iran emboldens adversaries and erodes the credibility of Western deterrence.

item.title: Cold War bunker 'waiting for Armageddon' found beneath medieval castle in 'perfect location'
item.summary: Experts uncovered a lost Cold War nuclear bunker on the grounds of Scarborough Castle, a medieval fortress in North Yorkshire, England. The hideout had been presumed lost.

item.title: American couple's Bahamas dinghy was ill-equipped for conditions night of wife's disappearance: friend
item.summary: A friend says Brian and Lynette Hooker's 8-foot dinghy was undersized and underpowered for the rough conditions the night she vanished in the Bahamas.

item.summary: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

item.title: Lowe's $250M bet on blue-collar jobs that AI can't do
item.summary: Lowe's CEO warns AI can't climb a ladder as the company makes a $250 million bet on blue-collar work amid rapid artificial intelligence advancement.

item.title: 'To Catch a Predator' host Chris Hansen warns Roblox dangers far worse than past online chatrooms
item.summary: Chris Hansen compared Roblox to an amusement park where kids are flying off rides, warning parents about what he claims is a surge of grooming.

item.title: Divorce boom may follow use of Ozempic and other GLP-1 drugs, experts warn
item.summary: Research suggests GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic and Wegovy could double divorce risk, mirroring trends seen in bariatric surgery patients, experts say.

item.title: Rep Randy Fine joins House Freedom Caucus: 'Strongest group of conservative patriots in Congress'
item.summary: Republican Rep. Randy Fine, who represents Florida's 6th Congressional District, has announced that he joined the conservative House Freedom Caucus.

item.title: Dems dodge on Trump removal as party weighs 25th Amendment move
item.summary: House Democrats are weighing a long-shot 25th Amendment effort to oust President Trump, though they lack the Republican support needed to succeed.
